_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Product & Maintenance (joyau recurring, 91% du CA), puis categories produits Cadence (Core EDA, SD&A, Semiconductor IP), puis recurring mix.

kpis.signal: Joyau Cadence 91% du CA, croissance double digit pluriannuelle, software licenses + IP + emulation hardware
kpis.description_fr: Revenus licences software EDA + semiconductor IP + sales/leases emulation hardware + maintenance. 91% du CA FY25. Recurring largement dominant, fondations modele financier Cadence.
kpis.description_en: EDA software licenses + semiconductor IP + emulation hardware sales/leases + maintenance. 91% of FY25 revenue. Largely recurring, foundation of Cadence financial model.

kpis.signal: CA $5,3Md, croissance pluriannuelle pres de +15%/an, beneficiare AI / 3D-IC / electrification
kpis.description_fr: CA total Cadence FY25. Croissance soutenue par GenAI / cloud-native EDA / 3D-IC / electrification, demande hardware Palladium / Protium et IP Artisan acquisition.
kpis.description_en: Cadence total revenue FY25. Growth driven by GenAI / cloud-native EDA / 3D-IC / electrification, demand for Palladium/Protium hardware and Artisan IP acquisition.

kpis.signal: 70% du CA FY25, Custom IC (Virtuoso) + Digital + Verification + Palladium/Protium emulation
kpis.description_fr: Categorie Core EDA = 70% du CA FY25 (5,297 multiplie par 70% = $3,708M). Inclut Virtuoso (custom IC), digital implementation, verification (Xcelium, Jasper), emulation hardware (Palladium, Protium).
kpis.description_en: Core EDA category = 70% of FY25 revenue ($5,297M times 70% = $3,708M). Includes Virtuoso (custom IC), digital implementation, verification (Xcelium, Jasper), emulation hardware (Palladium, Protium).

kpis.signal: 16% du CA, plateforme multiphysics (BETA CAE + Allegro + AWR) hors-EDA, croissance >+14%
kpis.description_fr: System Design & Analysis FY25 = 16% du CA. Allegro X / OrCAD X (PCB), Sigrity X (signal/power integrity), AWR (RF), plus BETA CAE acquise 2024 (simulation multiphysics). Hexagon D&E acquise septembre 2025 va amplifier.
kpis.description_en: SD&A FY25 = 16% of revenue. Allegro X / OrCAD X (PCB), Sigrity X (signal/power integrity), AWR (RF), plus BETA CAE acquired 2024 (multiphysics simulation). Hexagon D&E acquired Sept 2025 will amplify.

kpis.signal: 14% du CA FY25, croissance forte +22%, boostee acquisition Artisan IP (Arm), AI accelerators
kpis.description_fr: Semiconductor IP FY25 = 14% du CA (= $742M). Croissance forte portee par acquisition Artisan IP foundation business (Arm Limited) en 2025 plus Secure-IC. IP pour AI accelerators et chip design.
kpis.description_en: Semiconductor IP FY25 = 14% of revenue ($742M). Strong growth driven by Artisan IP foundation business acquisition (from Arm) in 2025 plus Secure-IC. IP for AI accelerators and chip design.

kpis.signal: 80% recurring FY25 (en baisse vs 83% car hardware up-front), modele recurring tres premium
kpis.description_fr: Part CA recurrent FY25: 80% (76% over-time + 4% other recurring). Up-front 20% (hardware Palladium/Protium et certains IP). Recurring assure visibilite mais hardware booste croissance ponctuelle.
kpis.description_en: Recurring revenue mix FY25: 80% (76% over-time + 4% other recurring). Up-front 20% (hardware Palladium/Protium and certain IP). Recurring ensures visibility but hardware boosts spot growth.
